questions.prompt: Which of these is a postulate of Euclid?
options: Opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal
A straight line can be drawn from any point to any other point
The angles of a triangle add to 180°
The angle in a semicircle is 90°

questions.prompt: In parallelogram ABCD, AB = 7 cm and BC = 4 cm. What is its perimeter in cm?

A chord of a circle of radius 10 cm is 6 cm from the centre. How long is the chord?
questions.explain: Half chord = √(100 − 36) = 8, so the chord is 16 cm.

questions.prompt: M and N are midpoints of two sides of a triangle, and MN = 7 cm. The third side is…
ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral with ∠A = (2x + 10)° and ∠C = (x + 20)°. Find x and ∠A.
questions.modelAnswer: Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral add to 180°: 2x + 10 + x + 20 = 180, so 3x = 150 and x = 50. Then ∠A = 2(50) + 10 = 110°.
questions.explain: Criterion A: applying a circle theorem.
